SELECT
    F.A_STOCKSNAME AS `股票名称`,
    F.A_STOCKCODE AS `股票代码`,
    F.DECLAREDATE AS `预告发布日期`,
    F.ENDDATE AS `业绩预告截止日期`,
    ROUND(F.MAX_VAL, 1) AS `归母净利润预测上限(万元)`,
    ROUND(F.MIN_VAL, 1) AS `归母净利润预测下限(万元)`,
    ROUND(F.EPS_CEIL, 3) AS `预计每股收益上限(元)`,
    ROUND(F.EPS_FLOR, 3) AS `预计每股收益下限(元)`,
    ROUND(F.NTINC_GR_CEIL, 2) AS `净利润同比增长上限(%)`,
    ROUND(F.NTINC_GR_FLOR, 2) AS `净利润同比增长下限(%)`,
    F.FORE_CLS AS `预测类型`,
    F.SUMMARY AS `预测摘要`,
    F.CONTENT AS `业绩预告内容`
FROM
    STK_ACHIEVE_FORECAST F
WHERE
    F.ISVALID = 1
    AND F.ENDDATE IN ('2024-12-31 00:00:00.000', '2025-03-31 00:00:00.000')
    AND F.DECLAREDATE >= '2025-07-01' AND F.DECLAREDATE < '2025-10-01'
    AND F.A_STOCKCODE IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    F.A_STOCKCODE ASC,
    F.DECLAREDATE DESC
